## Current

- Streaming csv parser ingests multi-GB files (2.3GB in 84s, 210MB peak RSS) [rec: calm-heron-0003].
- Pipeline layout: reader/validator modules under ingest/ [rec: dim-walrus-0004].

- [scope: ingest of files >2GB | confidence: medium | evidence: brisk-otter-0002] pandas chunked reader OOMs; do not revisit without a memory budget.

- calm-heron-0003 — streaming parser fix that made it work
- dim-walrus-0004 — current module layout
